verdict.rationale: RudderStack documents APIs to programmatically manage connections, transformations and libraries, plus audit logs, usage metrics and event audit, and it has an official MCP server covering debugging, monitoring and transformation testing. Nothing in the evidence claims or shows full UI parity, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity claim, API coverage for tracking plans, audiences, consent, alerts and live events, a published OpenAPI spec, and independent hands-on corroboration.
